pins.definition: A period of time lasting sixty minutes.

situation: Five different wristwatches lie in a row on a velvet cloth, one beside another, all showing the same moment: one single hand a quarter of the way round the dial from the top, with the dial's other hand at the top. Behind them stands a sand timer with all its sand run through. The watch faces have no numbers, only small round dots at each hour.
